conditions.runtime: Authenticated dedicated SMP for economy and shared-server gameplay; compatible client only renders server quotes

change.summary: Preserve single financial owner while adding bounded two-way Market supplier stock, exact native bulk budgets and replay-safe coin/payroll/founding operations.

before.value: Player purchases did not persist a distinct daily account/global supplier quantity

after.value: Separate persisted daily per-account and global BUY supplier counters; server quotes/action checks share current revisions; NPC SELL budgets remain separate

before.value: Receipt key replay lacked current source/destination/amount binding

after.value: New receipts bind source,destination,amount; altered-term replay INVALID; compatible historical receipts retained

before.value: Repeated same-lot candidate slots could overallocate the lot during denomination exchange

after.value: Subtract allocation accumulated across all same-lot slots before reserving each candidate

before.value: Starter receipt lifetime depended on bounded transaction history

after.value: Persist lifetime starter-recipient identity, recover legacy receipt facts, transfer existing central-reserve funds once; conserve money supply

before.unresolved: No equivalent complete opt-in runtime registry/recipe/native-provider projection

after.value: Explicit opt-in export only; never invoked in normal merchant interactions or as a new gameplay authority

rationale.purpose: Preserve single financial owner while adding bounded two-way Market supplier stock, exact native bulk budgets and replay-safe coin/payroll/founding operations.
rationale.decision_source: Direct user complete economy overhaul brief 2026-10-16; Docs/economy/overhaul-implementation.md
rationale.user_requested: Implement complete fair two-way Market/native professions, individual villagers, real exact Coin icons, native recruit hiring/seven-day wages/three missed weeks, paid settlements; preserve prior exclusions and native interfaces.
rationale.codex_choices: Exact editable prices/caps, acquisition-based admitted sets, transaction keys, safe discount floors, per-contract payroll schedule and client adapters are implementation/balance choices documented in owning source and final economy report.
